event.wanderer_warning.text: The wanderer blocks the path, hood low. "The warden still guards a fire that is long gone. Don't hate him for it." Behind him, a narrow trail glitters with shards.
event.wanderer_warning.follow: Take the glittering trail (lose 10 health, gain 70 shards)

boss.ember_warden.name: THE EMBER WARDEN
dialogue.maren_intro: There you are again. Ash to ash, and then back to you. Sit by the fire, little ember.
dialogue.maren_first_death: The first fall hurts the most. The Glut you carried back feeds the tree. Let me show you.
dialogue.maren_first_win: The Warden has fallen? Then the rift burns deeper than I feared. Rest. Then go further.
dialogue.maren_killed_warden: The Ember Warden has watched over the wastes since there were wastes. Its charge is wide, but its commitment is total. Dodge late.
dialogue.maren_killed_brute: A Shard Colossus? Its blow is slow. Be faster, and strike while it recovers.
dialogue.maren_killed_layer: Mines. Never stand where a Cinder Layer is looking.
dialogue.maren_killed_slag: Slag. The smallest things in the wastes. And still, here you are.
dialogue.maren_ignara: You smell of Ignara. She gives a lot, but she wants fire in return.
dialogue.maren_vaelis: Frost on your hands. Vaelis says little, but she listens to everything.
dialogue.maren_reached_boss: You stood before the Warden. Closer than most ever get.
dialogue.maren_runs5: Five times back from the ash. The tree grows with you, and so do you.
dialogue.maren_runs10: Some ask why you keep going. I stopped asking.
dialogue.maren_wins3: Three times through the wastes. The others have started telling stories about you.
dialogue.maren_filler_1: The fire's warm. The rift isn't going anywhere.
dialogue.maren_filler_2: Eat something. Even the branded need to eat.
dialogue.maren_filler_3: Every scar you bring back is a lesson. Read them.
dialogue.maren_filler_4: The embers whisper your name at night. I've learned to ignore it. Mostly.
dialogue.nix_intro: Well, well. A customer. I'm Nix. I have things. You have... dust? We'll get along.
dialogue.nix_dust: Elites carry rift dust inside them. Bring it to me and I'll put new relics in your path.
dialogue.nix_won: The Warden's down? Then its dust is free. Excellent for business.
dialogue.nix_killed_mite: Taken out by mites. I won't tell anyone. Almost anyone.
dialogue.nix_runs3: You know what I like about you? You always come back. Good customer.
dialogue.nix_reached_boss: You saw the big one, didn't you? I can tell. You've got that look.
dialogue.nix_filler_1: Browse all you like. Touching is extra.
dialogue.nix_filler_2: Prices are fair. Fair for me, anyway.
dialogue.nix_filler_3: If you find anything shiny out there, you know where I am.
dialogue.nix_filler_4: I'd come along, but someone has to mind the shop. And stay alive.

dialogue.sel_intro: Sit still a moment. The Brand on your skin isn't a wound, it's a script. I can teach you to read a few lines of it.
dialogue.sel_teach: Every spell is a pattern. Bring me what you find out there, and I'll weave it into you for good.
dialogue.sel_won: The Warden fell and the pattern still holds. You're writing something new into it.
dialogue.sel_killed_duelist: The Duelist reads your blade, not your runes. Strike from behind, or let a spell do the talking.
dialogue.sel_killed_twins: Spark and Ash are one pattern in two bodies. Cut the thread between them first.
dialogue.sel_killed_twins_ash: Ash is slow, but never alone for long. Pull them apart, then finish one quickly.
dialogue.sel_ignara: Ignara's fire spills into everything you cast. Careful: flames like to spread to their weaver.
dialogue.sel_vaelis: Vaelis's cold sharpens your focus. Spells come back faster when the mind is still.
dialogue.sel_runs3: Three returns. Your runes are getting louder. I can almost hear them from up here.
dialogue.sel_runs8: Patterns repeat until someone changes them. I think that someone might be you.
dialogue.sel_reached_boss: You stood before the Warden. Next time, bring a spell it hasn't seen yet.
dialogue.sel_filler_1: A meteor is just a promise the sky keeps. Aim it well.
dialogue.sel_filler_2: Auras are patient spells. Let them work while you fight.
dialogue.sel_filler_3: Rune Shards out there? Each one is a sentence. Collect enough and the spell speaks louder.
dialogue.sel_filler_4: Light, poison, frost, flame. Every school asks for a different kind of patience.

building.forge.desc: A cold hearth under fallen beams. With iron and embers it could burn again.
building.forge.level1: Toll moves in and forges armour (levels 1 and 2).
building.forge.level2: A second hearth: armour can be improved to level 3.
building.map_table.name: Map table
building.map_table.desc: A broken table with scraps of old maps.
building.map_table.level1: Iskra moves in. The world map shows which creatures live in each world.
building.map_table.level2: Better instruments: daily and weekly routes (coming later).
building.archive.name: Archive
building.archive.desc: Shelves full of soot, and somewhere in between, a book that turns its own pages.
building.archive.level1: The Archivist moves in. The codex follows later.
building.archive.level2: More shelves: more of the world's lore (coming later).

building.market.level1: Strings of lights over the stall.
building.market.level2: A second string of lights and a brighter market.
building.rune_tower.name: Rune tower
building.rune_tower.desc: Sel's tower. The runes up top have gone dark.
building.rune_tower.level1: A rune ring glows above the tower again.
building.rune_tower.level2: The ring grows and a core shines at its heart.
building.campfire.name: Campfire
building.campfire.desc: The heart of the refuge. It could be cosier.
building.campfire.level1: Benches around the fire. You can now decorate the refuge.
building.campfire.level2: Lantern posts and a fire that burns brighter.

dialogue.toll_intro: Hmph. Somebody finally lit this hearth. Toll. Smith. Don't touch the anvil, it bites.
dialogue.toll_filler_1: Good iron sings when you strike it. Slag iron mostly complains.
dialogue.toll_filler_2: Bring me more material. The hammer gets bored.
dialogue.iskra_intro: Oh! Oh, a table! And maps! I'm Iskra, I draw where things are, and where they were, and sometimes where they'll be, mostly wrong.
dialogue.iskra_filler_1: The Ember Wastes shift every time you go. That's not a mistake on my map. Probably.
dialogue.iskra_filler_2: If you see a sea made of glass, tell me everything. Everything!
dialogue.archivist_intro: You have returned. Or arrived. The book is unsure which. I keep what the worlds forget.
dialogue.archivist_filler_1: Every rift leaves a page. Most are blank. Some are not.
dialogue.archivist_filler_2: Ask later. The ink is still wet.

quest_item.warden_ash.name: the Warden's Ash
quest.story_first_spark.name: The first spark
quest.story_first_spark.desc: Make it to the heart of the Ember Wastes.
quest.story_first_spark.offer: Something burns at the heart of the Ember Wastes. Go and see it with your own eyes, child. Just see it.
quest.story_first_spark.done: You saw it. The Warden. So it is true.
quest.story_rekindle_forge.name: Rekindle the forge
quest.story_rekindle_forge.desc: Rebuild the forge in the refuge.
quest.story_rekindle_forge.offer: We need iron that holds. Rebuild the forge, and someone will come to work it.
quest.story_rekindle_forge.done: Listen. A hammer. It has been years.
quest.story_twin_fire.name: Twin fire
quest.story_twin_fire.desc: Defeat the twins of fire and ash.
quest.story_twin_fire.offer: Two flames guard the paths, fire and ash, one feeding the other. Break them apart.
quest.story_twin_fire.done: One fire alone is just a fire. Well done.
quest.story_warden_ash.name: The Warden's Ash
quest.story_warden_ash.desc: Find the Warden's Ash in an event room of the Ember Wastes.
quest.story_warden_ash.offer: The Warden was one of us, long ago. Somewhere out there lies what is left of who it was. Bring it to me.
quest.story_warden_ash.done: Cold ash. And still it remembers its name. I will teach you the fire it once knew.
quest.story_warden_falls.name: The Warden falls
quest.story_warden_falls.offer: It is time. Give the Warden its rest.
quest.story_warden_falls.done: The Wastes are quiet. For the first time, I hear the wind.
quest.errand_toll_cores.name: Cores for the anvil
quest.errand_toll_cores.offer: Three ember cores. Good ones. Not the cracked junk.
quest.errand_toll_iron.name: Iron supply
quest.errand_toll_iron.offer: Bring back slag iron from your trips. A dozen. I'll count.
quest.errand_toll_iron.done: Twelve. Exactly twelve. You can count.
quest.errand_maren_burn.name: Let it burn
quest.errand_maren_burn.offer: Fire is a tool, not a temper. Show me you can use it: thirty burning foes.
quest.errand_maren_flawless.name: Untouched
quest.errand_maren_flawless.offer: The best wound is the one you never get. Three rooms, not a scratch.
quest.errand_maren_flawless.done: Not a scratch. I worried for nothing.
quest.errand_sel_frost.name: Cold lessons
quest.errand_sel_frost.offer: Frost is a slow letter. Write twenty-five of them, and I'll read them back to you.
quest.errand_sel_poison.name: Green script
quest.errand_sel_poison.offer: Poison writes in green. Twenty lines, please.
quest.errand_nix_iron.name: A small delivery
quest.errand_nix_iron.offer: I have a buyer who loves slag iron. Don't ask. Eight pieces?
quest.errand_nix_duelist.name: The duelist's blade
quest.errand_nix_duelist.offer: The Duelist owes me money. Well, owed. Remind it, would you?
quest.errand_iskra_boss.name: Mapping the heart
quest.errand_iskra_boss.desc: Reach the boss of the Ember Wastes.
quest.errand_iskra_boss.offer: I need the last bit of the map! The middle! Where the big angry one is!
quest.errand_iskra_boss.done: Oh, that's a much bigger room than I drew.
quest.errand_archivist_cores.name: Embers for the record
quest.errand_archivist_cores.offer: Five cores. Each holds a memory. Gather them, and they will be written down.
scene.ember_warden_intro.1: Another spark. Another one who thinks this fire can be carried home.
scene.ember_warden_intro.2: I kept watch over it when it was warm. I keep watch now. Turn back.
scene.ember_warden_intro.3: Can't. Tried dying already. Doesn't take.
scene.ember_warden_outro.1: The mark… on your skin. I wore it once.
scene.ember_warden_outro.2: Tell the keeper… I never stopped watching.
scene.ember_duelist_intro.1: Draw. Let's see if the spark has a point.
scene.twin_spark_intro.2: Feed it to me. I'm always so cold.
being.ignara.loyal: My fire suits you. Burn brighter.
being.ignara.rival: Vaelis's frost on you? Let me thaw that.
being.vaelis.loyal: Still and clear. You are learning.
being.vaelis.rival: So much heat. Let me cool your head.
dialogue.maren_quest_first_spark: You saw the Warden's fire with your own eyes. Good. Now you know what we are up against. And what we lost.
dialogue.maren_quest_forge: Hear that? Hammer on iron. The refuge hasn't sounded like that in a hundred winters.
dialogue.maren_quest_twins: Two sparks bound into one fire. They were meant to burn together. Everything out there was, once.
dialogue.maren_quest_ash: The Warden was a spark like you. I knew. I should have told you before you raised your blade.
dialogue.maren_quest_falls: The Warden can rest now. You gave it what none of us could: an ending. Thank you.
dialogue.maren_warden_active: When you face the Warden again, look at its eyes. Whatever is left in there still remembers the hearth.
dialogue.maren_knows_warden: There were sparks before you. Many. I lit each one of them and sent them out. Not all of them came back as themselves.
dialogue.maren_wanderer_hint: A stranger by a fire, you say? Kind voice, grey hood? ... No. It can't be. Eat something, little ember.
dialogue.maren_wanderer_silent: Don't ask me about the wanderer again. Some names are easier to carry when nobody says them.
dialogue.maren_campfire: A real fire in the square again. Sit with the others sometimes. They need to see you're more than a blade.
dialogue.maren_archive: The archivist has woken. Be careful what you ask. He answers the questions you didn't mean to ask.
dialogue.maren_lost_after_win: Even after a victory, the ash takes you back sometimes. That's not failure. That's the road.
dialogue.maren_runs20: Twenty times you've come back to me. The ones before you stopped counting. Don't you stop.
dialogue.maren_filler_5: The fire is low today. It always is, before a long walk.
dialogue.maren_filler_6: I keep a name for every spark I lit. Yours is the only one I still say out loud.
dialogue.maren_filler_7: Listen to them laughing at the fire. I had forgotten that sound.
dialogue.nix_market: A real stall! With a roof! Darling, I could weep. I won't, it's bad for the merchandise.
dialogue.nix_wanderer: The hooded one? Oh, he never buys anything. Just stares at my lanterns. Bad for business, good for gossip.
dialogue.nix_beyond: Where am I from? Somewhere with fewer hearths and more teeth. You'd hate it. I mostly did.
dialogue.nix_other_customers: Do I sell to the others? The flame one, the frost one? A trader doesn't ask who's at the counter. ... Forget I said that.
dialogue.nix_ignara: Ignara's fire all over you. She tips well, you know. Don't tell her I said so.
dialogue.nix_vaelis: Brr. Vaelis again? That one haggles for an hour and then buys nothing. Typical frost.
dialogue.nix_warden_falls: The Warden's gone quiet? Shame. It was my best customer for ember cores. Kidding! Mostly.
dialogue.nix_killed_warden: Flattened by the big burning one? Next time, buy something that blocks. I have three of those. Probably.
dialogue.nix_killed_duelist: The duelist? All flourish, no manners. Let it lunge, then step aside. Free advice, just this once.
dialogue.nix_wins3: Three wins! My little investment is paying off. I mean you. You're the investment.
dialogue.nix_filler_5: Fresh stock every week. Well, fresh-ish. Well, stock.
dialogue.nix_filler_6: Everything has a price. Even me. Especially me.
dialogue.nix_filler_7: Don't touch the blue jar. It touches back.
dialogue.sel_brand_1: Your brand has new lines today. Not runes. Letters. Someone is writing to you through your own skin.
dialogue.sel_brand_2: I read one word in your brand: "again". I don't like that word. It has too many sparks behind it.
dialogue.sel_brand_3: The Warden's ash and your brand share a pattern. Same hand lit you both. I think you knew that already.
dialogue.sel_brand_4: Since the Warden fell, one line in your brand has gone quiet. As if a sentence were finished. The letter goes on.
dialogue.sel_rune_tower: A tower for the runes. Up here the patterns are clearer. And so is what they're afraid of.
dialogue.sel_wanderer: The wanderer's voice has a pattern too. It repeats like someone who has said goodbye too often.
dialogue.sel_wins3: Three victories. The pattern bends toward you now. Don't let it make you careless.
dialogue.sel_filler_5: Every spark is a sentence. I'm trying to read yours before it ends.
dialogue.sel_filler_6: Wind, then ember, then silence. That is the rhythm today.
dialogue.sel_filler_7: Your name is in there somewhere. Under the burns. I'll find it.
dialogue.toll_first_armor: Stand still. No, stiller. I'm measuring you for something that holds. This time it holds.
dialogue.toll_apprentice_1: I had an apprentice once. Followed a spark out into the ash. Said my armour was good enough. It wasn't.
dialogue.toll_apprentice_2: So the Warden was one of Maren's sparks. Then maybe my apprentice is out there too, still marching. Don't tell me if you find out.
dialogue.toll_lost: Dented. Scorched. Bring it here. Armour is meant to come back broken. You aren't.
dialogue.toll_won: Came back in one piece. My piece held. ... Good. That's good. Now get out, I'm working.
dialogue.toll_killed_brute: The colossus hits like my old anvil falling over. Plate won't save you. Distance will.
dialogue.toll_cores: Ember cores. Bring me ember cores. Fire that remembers being a hearth is the only fire worth hammering.
dialogue.toll_wins3: Three times you've beaten that thing. Maybe I'm not as bad a smith as I think. Maybe.
dialogue.toll_filler_3: Hmph. Your left pauldron sits crooked. Everything sits crooked. Hand it over.
dialogue.toll_filler_4: Iron doesn't lie. People do. That's why I talk to iron.
dialogue.toll_filler_5: I keep one empty hook on the wall. For when the boy comes back.
dialogue.iskra_drift_1: Okay, so, weird thing: I measured the wastes twice and they've MOVED. Not much! But toward the rift. Is that bad? That feels bad.
dialogue.iskra_drift_2: Every fragment drifts a little closer to the heart each night. At this rate ... no, I'm not saying it. I'll draw it. Look. Don't look.
dialogue.iskra_map_table: A table! A real one! I can spread out ALL the maps! Okay, most of them. Some of them are on fire.
dialogue.iskra_wanderer: I tried to put the hooded wanderer on my map. He's never where I draw him. He's always where you are.
dialogue.iskra_boss: You got all the way to the Warden! I marked the path. In red. Red means "brave". Also "danger". Mostly brave.
dialogue.iskra_warden_falls: The wastes stopped drifting for a whole night after the Warden fell! One night! That's data! That's hope with numbers!
dialogue.iskra_lost: You fell in room ... wait, let me guess ... the one with the jagged pillars? Everyone falls there. I should put a sign.
dialogue.iskra_filler_3: North is wherever the ash isn't blowing. That's a rule I made up. It works sometimes!
dialogue.iskra_filler_4: Someday I'll map the rift itself. From very, very far away. With a long pencil.
dialogue.iskra_filler_5: Shortcuts! There must be shortcuts. Old hearth roads, hidden doors. I just need to find them. You could find them!
dialogue.archivist_sparks: I have shelves for every spark that walked out of this refuge. Most of them are full. Yours is still very thin.
dialogue.archivist_warden: The Warden. Third shelf from the door. It was proud of its first fire. I may not say more. I am sorry.
dialogue.archivist_wanderer: The wanderer has no shelf. He had one. Someone took the book out. Perhaps he did.
dialogue.archivist_maren: Ask the keeper about the night the hearth broke. Not today. When she is tired of carrying it alone.
dialogue.archivist_warden_falls: A book closed today. Gently. It has been a long time since one closed gently.
dialogue.archivist_lost: Another page for your shelf. Falling is also something worth writing down.
dialogue.archivist_wins3: Three victories. Few before you reached three. None reached four. Curious, is it not?
dialogue.archivist_filler_3: Dust is only memory that has given up. Keep moving.
dialogue.archivist_filler_4: I remember everything. That is not the same as being allowed to say it.
dialogue.archivist_filler_5: The ink on your page is still wet. Good.
dialogue.maren_forge_built: Toll has his hammer back. Let him grumble at you. That's how he says he cares.
dialogue.maren_map_table: Iskra talks faster than the wind. Listen anyway. She sees what the rest of us are too tired to see.
dialogue.maren_twins_active: The twins fight as one. Separate them, and each remembers it is alone. That is when they falter.
dialogue.maren_ash_active: The Warden's ash lies where the fire was oldest. Look near the altars. And come back, whatever you learn.
dialogue.nix_twins: Two of them? I'd charge double for that. They're charging you double. Rude.
dialogue.nix_filler_8: Prices are up since the Warden went quiet. Supply and demand, darling. Mostly demand for me.
dialogue.sel_twins: The twins left a mark on your brand. Two lines that cross once and never again. A sad shape.
dialogue.toll_forge_quest: The forge burns. Don't thank me, thank the cores. And the fool who carried them. That's you.
dialogue.iskra_twins: The twins! I've been sketching them. One always circles left. ALWAYS. Use that! Probably!
dialogue.archivist_campfire: Voices at the fire again. I am writing them down. It is the first happy chapter in a long time.
node.puzzle.name: Puzzle
node.puzzle.desc: No fight: an old mechanism bars the way. Solve it for a relic and materials.
puzzle.four_bowls.name: The Four Bowls
puzzle.four_bowls.hint: Count the little dots under each bowl! One dot first, then two, then three. Strike them in that order.
puzzle.rune_path.name: The Rune Path
puzzle.rune_path.hint: The runes have dots too. Step on one dot, then two, and so on. Careful not to walk over the wrong one on the way!
puzzle.ember_switch.name: The Ember Switch
puzzle.ember_switch.hint: The crystal keeps the gate open only for a moment. Hit it, then run, and dash over the drop without stopping!
puzzle.crystal_island.name: The Crystal Island
puzzle.crystal_island.hint: Too far to dash, too far to swing. But your rift shot flies over the abyss!
puzzle.stone_plates.name: The Stone Plates
puzzle.stone_plates.hint: Walk into a block and keep leaning: it slides one step. Each plate wants a block. Stuck? Hit the reset stone.
puzzle.twin_fires.name: The Twin Fires
puzzle.twin_fires.hint: One gate wants a weight on its plate, the other a spark on the floating crystal. Then light both fires.
node.start.name: Entrance
node.start.desc: Where you came in. Quiet, for now.
node.treasure.name: Treasure
